name: bro-plus
description: Bro_plus — one screen-share-invisible Chromium browser that fuses Browse + a Postman-class API client + a Burp-class intercepting proxy, as build-selectable plugins.
author: Mahajan
comment:deps: Browser deps come from Bro (castlabs Electron = Electron + Widevine, Ghostery adblock, Chrome extensions + Web Store, WebTorrent, electron-updater). Install with `npm install --install-links` so the webrtc-polyfill stub is copied, not linked. better-sqlite3 (proxy history) is still a future dep — it needs node-gyp/MSVC; JSONL history is the fallback. quickjs-emscripten = the API client's script sandbox (WebAssembly, no native build); yaml = OpenAPI YAML import.
